faq.q: How much of Langley is in the ALR?
faq.a: The Township of Langley states 235 square kilometres of the Township is within the Agricultural Land Reserve; check a specific parcel on the ALC maps.

faq.q: Do I need a licence to use well water on a farm?
faq.a: Domestic groundwater use is exempt from licensing; groundwater used for non-domestic purposes such as irrigation requires a water licence under the Water Sustainability Act, and well records are searched in the GWELLS registry.
